name: Drannith Magistrate
oracle_text: Your opponents can't cast spells from anywhere other than their hands.
blocked_sentences: Your opponents can't cast spells from anywhere other than their hands.

needs.what: a player-wide static casting prohibition filtered by the zone the spell is cast FROM, lasting while the source is on the battlefield: affects_player "opponent" plus zones/except_zones (here except_zones: ["hand"]), read at every cast road (casting._cast_variant and the resolution-time casts: suspend.cast_for_free, replacements._offer_cast, cast_copy) exactly as the CastLock table is today
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `cant_cast_spells` static is total or filtered only by printed spell characteristics (affects_spells via _matches_printed) and has no zone-of-origin key, so written bare it would also forbid the opponents' hand casts -- a far harsher card. The `cant_cast_spells_from_zones` op does carry except_zones, but it is a one-shot that installs a timed CastLock whose durations are only this_turn / until_your_next_turn (CAST_LOCK_DURATIONS); there is no 'as long as the source is on the battlefield' duration and no static_effect form, so a self_enters trigger using it would expire while Magistrate is still out.
